grounding_boundary: Device-free PyLabRobot reference behavior only; no Hamilton hardware observation.

observations.state_effect: LiquidHandler setup becomes finished; repeated setup raises RuntimeError.
Tip leaves its TipSpot and mounts channel 0; a second pickup on that channel raises HasTipError.
100 uL moves from source to the mounted tip; no-tip and source-underflow requests raise NoTipError and TooLittleLiquidError.
100 uL moves from the mounted tip to target; tip-underflow and container-overflow requests raise TooLittleLiquidError and TooLittleVolumeError.
return_tips restores the origin TipSpot and clears channel 0; an occupied destination raises HasTipError and a repeated return raises RuntimeError.
LiquidHandler setup becomes unfinished; repeated stop raises RuntimeError.
